<details>

In response to [this](https://github.com/openshift/aws-karpenter-provider-aws/pull/31):

>On OpenShift, setting an ownerReference with blockOwnerDeletion requires update permission on the owner's /finalizers subresource. Karpenter sets blockOwnerDeletion on NodeClaims (owner: NodePool) and Nodes (owner: NodeClaim), so the core ClusterRole needs nodepools/finalizers and nodeclaims/finalizers.
>
>We don't use the chart in OpenShift, but we copy over the rbac from the chart to the karpenter-operator manifests in order to sync them from a known place (upstream chart).
